title: eludite.navigation.go_to_* input
description: Go To Implementation (Ctrl+F12), Go To Type Definition, Go To Base (Alt+Home) and Go To Derived Symbols (Alt+End): ask the document's language server for the targets of the symbol at `line`, `column` (or the caret). One target opens at once (the position before is pushed on the navigation history); several show the picker Go To Definition shows. A new call cancels the previous request; an answer for an older document version or solution generation is dropped.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

target.description: Choose target `target` (0-based, in the order of the output's `targets`) of the picker the previous call opened.
